snippet.title: UNIT 42: Adrift in Space - First trailer
snippet.description:
UNIT 42: Adrift in Space is an incremental journey through space. Manage your ship's capsules, choose your path through the stars, and watch your crew and automation do the rest.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414400/UNIT_42_Adrift_in_Space/
